name: Fisherman

legendary_skill.name: Gone Fishing
legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn): When you Normal Summon WATER monster, you can roll a die. Reveal that many cards from the top of your Deck and add 1 WATER monster from among those to your hand, then shuffle the rest back into the Deck.

legendary_quest: If you reveal a “Terrorking Salmon” off of your “Gone Fishing” ability, you can Special Summon a “Terrorking Salmon” from your hand or Deck after “Gone Fishing” resolves. If you summon it from your hand, draw 1 card.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): You can discard 1 “Terrorking Salmon” to activate “Gone Fishing”, and add 5 to the result of the dice roll. (Once per Duel): If you control “Terrorking Salmon”, you can destroy 1 Fish monster from among the cards you revealed from “Gone Fishing”, and if you do, give “Terrorking Salmon” ATK/DEF equal to the ATK/DEF of the destroyed card until the end of the next turn.

starting_skills.name: Grey Aura
starting_skills.description: "White Aura" monsters Summoned from the GY are banished when they leave the field. This skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Necromancer

legendary_skill.name: Look Ma, No Hands!
legendary_skill.description: When you draw a card(s) reveal it (including your opening hand), and if it is a level 4 or lower monster, send it to the GY. Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 level 4 or lower Zombie type monster from your GY but you cannot Normal Summon/Set monsters for the rest of the turn.

legendary_quest: (Thrice per Duel): You can send 1 “Skull Servant” from your Deck to your GY. (Once per Duel): If you have 3 “Skull Servant” in your GY, you can Special Summon 1 “Skull Servant” from your GY.
legendary_relic: “Skull Servant” you control gain 1000 ATK for each “Skull Servant” in your GY. (Once per Duel): You can banish 1 “Skull Servant” from your GY to give 1 “Skull Servant” you control 2000 ATK until the end of the next turn.

name: Toy Maker

legendary_skill.name: Patchwork
legendary_skill.description: If you activate "Polymerization" you can use 2 monsters that each have exactly 1 of the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK or DEF as a Fusion monster, but do not share it with each other as Fusion Material for that Fusion monster ignoring summoning conditions. If you Fusion Summon "Bickuribox" it gains ATK equal to the combined Levels/Ranks/Link Ratings of the Fusion Materials used for it x 50 until the End Phase.

legendary_quest: If you Fusion Summon “Bickuribox”, you can complete your Legendary Quest. If you used 2 monsters with different archetypes, “Bickuribox” becomes part of those archetypes, and the Fusion Materials for "Bickuribox" becomes 1 monster each from any of those archetypes for the rest of the game (ex: 1 “Fluffal” monster + 1 “Shaddoll” monster).
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): If you control "Bickuribox", you can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck or GY to your hand. (Once per turn): If you Fusion Summon a monster other than “Bickuribox”, you can make 1 “Bickuribox” you control gain 200 ATK.

name: Allen

legendary_skill.name: Corruption Cells
legendary_skill.description: If a Reptile monster battles an opponent's monster, place 1 A-Counter on that opponent's monster at the end of the Damage Step if it was not destroyed. (Once per turn): If an A-Counter(s) is removed, you can add 1 Reptile monster from your Deck to your hand with a level less than or equal to the number of A-Counters removed.

legendary_quest: If a monster with an A-Counter(s) your opponent controls leaves the field, you can Special Summon "Alien Shocktrooper" from your hand and place 1 A-Counter on each face-up monster on the field.
legendary_relic: If “Alien Shocktrooper” is Summoned, you can place 4 A-Counters on monsters on the field, distributed as you wish. (Once per turn): You can remove any number of A-Counters on the field; this turn, if you would tribute a Reptile monster you can tribute a monster your opponent controls whose Level/Rank is less than or equal to the number of removed A-Counters instead.

name: Pyromancer

legendary_skill.name: Everlasting Hellfire of Creation
legendary_skill.description: At the start of the Duel, you can send 2 Dragon monsters with different names from your Deck to the GY and banish 1 "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" from your Deck. During your 2nd Standby Phase after this, add that "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" to your hand. (Once per turn): If a FIRE monster is sent from your hand or Deck to the GY, you can banish 1 FIRE monster from your GY and add 1 banished FIRE monster with a different name to your hand.

legendary_quest: You can banish 2 FIRE monsters from your GY to Special Summon "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" from your hand. When it leaves the field, return all your banished FIRE monsters to the GY.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): You can banish 1 FIRE monster from your GY and discard 1 card to have a "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" you control gain ATK equal to half the banished monster's ATK until the end of the turn. (Once per turn): If you don't control a face-up "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon", you can banish 6 FIRE monsters from your GY to Special Summon 1 "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" from your GY. If "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" destroys a monster by battle, you can send 1 FIRE monster from your Deck to the GY.
base_cards: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6

name: Mage

legendary_skill.name: Mirror Images
legendary_skill.description: (During each of your Draw Phases): You can reveal any number of Spells in your hand, Summon a “Mirror Image” Token (Spellcaster/DARK/Level 7) with ATK/DEF equal to the number of Spells revealed x 500. Destroy it during the End Phase. You do not discard for hand size.

legendary_quest: You can remove from the field 1 "Mirror Image" token that has ATK/DEF greater than or equal to 1500, then Special Summon "Neo Aqua Madoor" from your hand, and if you do, summon a "Neo Aqua Mirror" token (Spellcaster/WATER/Level 6/ATK 1200/DEF 3000) to your field.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): You can remove 1 "Mirror Image" token with 2500 or more ATK from the field to Special Summon "Neo Aqua Madoor" from your hand. While “Neo Aqua Madoor” is face-up on the field, draw 1 additional card during each player's Draw Phase.

name: Gardener

legendary_skill.name: Sowing Seeds
legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn): When you active this skill, you can also Tribute 1 Plant monster; draw 1 card and place 1 card from your hand on top of your Deck, or, if you tributed a monster when you activated this skill, take 1 Plant monster whose level is 1 higher or lower than the Tributed monster and place it on top of the Deck instead of from your hand.

legendary_quest: (Once per turn) During your Draw Phase before you draw: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant monster, send it to the GY. If a "Mandragon" is sent from the Deck to the GY, Special Summon it and complete your Legendary Quest.
legendary_relic: You can Tribute 1 Plant monster; place a “Mandragon” from your face-up Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zone. (Once per turn): If a monster is Tributed while "Mandragon" is in the Pendulum Zone, you can Special Summon it. "Mandragon" in your Monster Zone gains the effect (check notes): "Once per turn, during your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can excavate cards from the top of your Deck, equal to the number of other Plant monsters you control, and if you excavated any Plant monsters, send them to the GY, also shuffle the other cards back into your Deck.

name: Acrobat

legendary_skill.name: Sick Flips
legendary_skill.description: If your opponent Summons a monster(s): You can Flip Summon 1 monster you control. “Ancient Jar” is treated as a Flip Monster.

legendary_quest: If “Ancient Jar” is Flip Summoned: You can Set 1 monster from your hand to the field, and if you do discard as many cards from your hand as possible, and draw 5 cards.
legendary_relic: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Flip monster from your hand in face-up or face-down Defense position. (Once per turn): If “Ancient Jar” is flipped face-up: You can change 1 monster other than “Ancient Jar” to face-down Defense Position.

name: Priest

legendary_skill.name: Be Not Afraid
legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn): You can choose a number between 1-3, then send that many cards from the top of your Deck to the GY, but lose LP equal to the combined levels of monsters sent x 100. (Once per turn): During the End Phase, if a Fairy or LIGHT monster was destroyed by battle this turn, you can banish 1 Fairy or LIGHT monster from your GY and gain LP equal to its ATK.

legendary_quest: If a Fairy or LIGHT monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Special Summon “Hourglass of Life” from your hand or GY in ATK position. It cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.
legendary_relic: While you control “Hourglass of Life”, Fairy and LIGHT monsters you control gain 300 ATK during your turn, also, each time you Summon a Fairy or LIGHT monster(s), gain 300LP. During the Standby Phase the turn after “Hourglass of Life” was Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Fairy or LIGHT monster from your GY, except "Hourglass of Life". (Once per turn): You can place 1 of your banished Fairy or LIGHT monsters on top of your Deck.

name: Warrior

legendary_skill.name: Secret Village Training
legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn) (During your Draw Phase): You can send 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to the GY. Warrior monsters you control gain 100 ATK/DEF for each Warrior monster with a different Level in your GY.

legendary_quest: You can banish 3 Warrior-type monsters with different Levels from your GY; Special Summon "Ansatsu" from your hand, and if you do, you can destroy 1 monster on the field, and if it wasn’t a Legendary Monster, both players must destroy cards with that same name from their hand, field, and/or Deck. This is treated as by a card effect.
legendary_relic:
While you control another Warrior type monster, except "Ansatsu", "Ansatsu" cannot be targeted for attacks. (Once per turn): If a monster you control is destroyed by battle, you can discard Warrior monsters from your hand (min 2) so that the total level of discarded monsters is equal to or exceeds the Level/Rank of the monster that destroyed your monster; destroy it, then you can add 1 Warrior monster from your banishment to your hand.
NERF SKILL FOR DRAGON OGRE

name: Wizard

legendary_skill.name: Spellbook
legendary_skill.description: During the first Draw Phase, banish the top 5 cards of your Deck face-down to make your Spellbook. (Once per turn): You can add 1 monster and immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon it, or add 1 Spell/Trap card or Pendulum Monster Card and immediately activate it, from among your face-down banished cards.

legendary_quest: You can shuffle your face-down banished cards back into your Deck and Special Summon 1 “Boo Koo” from your hand, then banish the top 5 cards of your Deck face-down.
legendary_relic: While “Boo Koo” is face-up on the field, you can activate Spellbook an additional time each turn but cannot add the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap) twice a turn. (Once per Duel): You can shuffle 1 “Boo Koo” from your GY into the Deck, then banish 1 Spell Card from your Deck face-down.

name: Pirate

legendary_skill.name: Buried Treasure!
legendary_skill.description: Pirate gains all Treasures shown during the Shop Phase. (Once per turn): If you Normal Summon a WATER monster, you can banish cards from the top of your Deck equal to the level of that monster, then place a Booty counter on this Skill. (Once per Duel): You can spend up to 3 Booty counters to add that many banished cards to your hand.

legendary_quest: You can immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute 1 WATER monster and Normal Summon 1 “Skull Mariner” from your hand or among your banished monsters, then you can equip 1 banished monster to that card.
legendary_relic:
If you Summon “Skull Mariner”, you can equip 1 banished monster to that card. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle a card equipped to “Skull Mariner” into the Deck to equip 1 banished card to “Skull Mariner”. "Skull Mariner" gains the following effect based on the level of the monster equipped to it:
Level 3 or lower: This card gains ATK equal to its DEF.
Level 4: You can Special Summon a monster equipped to this card, and if you do, return this card to your hand.
Level 5 or higher: (Quick Effect): You can shuffle 1 Level 5 or higher monster equipped to this card into the Deck and target 1 face-up monster on the field; it can’t attack this turn, also, you can change its battle position.

name: Druid

legendary_skill.name: Shapeshift
legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn): At the end of the Battle Phase, If a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster you control battled: You can shuffle a face-up Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster you control into the Deck, also Special Summon 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast from your hand or Deck with the same Level/Rank, but with a different name as that shuffled monster.

legendary_quest: If a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster you control destroys a monster by battle, you can immediately Shapeshift into “Gladiator Beast Andal” using that monster, ignoring the level requirement, and if you do, “Gladiator Beast Andal” you currently control gain 600 ATK.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): You can reveal 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster in your hand, shuffle it into the Deck, then add 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast from your Deck to your hand with the same level, but with a different name as that shuffled monster.

name: Velociraptor

legendary_skill.name: Dino DNA
legendary_skill.description: Monsters in your possession are also treated as Dinosaur monsters. During your Battle Phase, you, the Velociraptor, gain 1500 ATK, plus 200 for each STR you have, and you can declare an attack as if you were an attack position monster, but you cannot attack directly.

legendary_quest: You can destroy 1 Dinosaur monster you control, Special Summon “Absolute King - Megaplunder” from your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur monster from your Deck. This is treated as a card effect.
legendary_relic:
(Once per turn): If a non-Effect monster(s) you control is destroyed by a card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur monster from your Deck.  “Absolute King - Megaplunder” gains the effect (Check notes):
You can destroy 1 monster you control, or if you control a non-Effect monster, you can destroy 1 monster in your hand instead, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Absolute King - Megaplunder" once per turn.

name: Slime

legendary_skill.name: Absorb!
legendary_skill.description: You absorb the class of your opponent. You gain access to their cards and can purchase their class loot in your shop.

legendary_quest: Absorb the class of your opponent.
legendary_relic: While you have absorbed a class, you can use their Legendary Skill, Quest, and Relic.

legendary_skill.name: Copycat!
legendary_skill.description: You copy your opponent's class, cards, skills, and treasures directly. You do not have a Shop Phase.

name: Miner

legendary_skill.name: Diggin’ for GemsYou do not Draw during your Draw Phase. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, then if you control no monsters, you can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 4 or lower EARTH or Rock monster, or if you do control a monster(s), you can add 1 excavated EARTH or Rock monster to your hand, also shuffle the rest back into your Deck. (Once per turn): You can reveal 1 EARTH or Rock Normal Monster in your hand; shuffle it back into your Deck and draw 1 card.

legendary_quest: If you excavate "Prisman" off of Diggin' for Gems, you can Special Summon it even if you control a monster, and complete your Quest also you can add 1 Treasure from your Deck to your hand.
legendary_relic: If you excavate “Prisman” from Diggin' for Gems, you can add 1 “Prisman” from your Deck to your hand. “Prisman” can be treated as a Tuner for a Synchro Summon, as a Level 4 for an XYZ Summon, is also always treated as all Attributes, and can be used as any 1 Fusion Material for a Fusion Summon. (Once per Duel): You can banish 3 cards with different names from your GY (any combination of EARTH or Rock monsters, and Spell Cards); add 1 Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Spider

legendary_skill.name: Cocooned
legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn): You can equip 1 Level 4 or lower Insect monster, or 1 "Hunter Spider" from your hand or GY to a monster on the field. (Once per turn): During your End Phase, you can Special Summon 1 Insect Monster Card equipped to a monster.

legendary_quest: You can Special Summon "Hunter Spider" from your hand, and equip 1 monster with an Equip Card to it, also equip any cards equipped to that monster to "Hunter Spider".
legendary_relic: "Hunter Spider" gains ATK equal to its DEF while there is an Insect equipped with a monster on the field. If a monster equipped with an Equip Card would be destroyed, you can destroy a card equipped to it instead. (Once per turn): You can send 1 card equipped to "Hunter Spider" to the GY; Special Summon 1 Monster Card from your face-up Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Gambler

legendary_skill.name: Gateway Drug
legendary_skill.description:
Before an effect that tosses a coin, rolls a die, or randomly discards a card resolves, you can declare one of the outcomes of that effect. If you're correct, place 1 Lucky Counter on this Skill, otherwise take 500 damage. You can remove any number of Lucky Counters from this Skill to apply one of these effects (but you cannot apply that same effect again this turn) (Check notes):
1 Counter: When a card effect tosses a coin or rolls a die. you can redo your coin toss or die roll.
2 Counters: Shuffle 2 cards with an effect that tosses a coin, rolls a die, or randomly discards a card from your GY into the Deck, then draw 1 card.
3 Counters: Add 1 card with an effect that tosses a coin, rolls a die, or randomly discards a card or 1 "Slot Machine" from your Deck to your hand.

legendary_quest: If a Lucky Counter is placed on Gateway Drug you can remove up to 3, and Special Summon 1 "Slot Machine" from your hand, then you can apply the appropriate effect based on how many Counters you removed.
legendary_relic: While you control "Slot Machine", place an additional Lucky Counter on Gateway Drug anytime a Counter is placed on it. Once per turn, while you control "Slot Machine": You can discard 1 card and declare 1 card type, excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck then add 1 of those cards with the declared card type to your hand, also shuffle the rest into the Deck. If you excavate 3 cards of the declared card type, "Slot Machine" you control cannot be destroyed until the end of the next turn.

name: Cyborg

legendary_skill.name: Weakness of Flesh
legendary_skill.description:
Once per turn, if you activate the effect of a “Gadget” monster, immediately after this effect resolves: You can Normal Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Machine monster.
Legendary MonsterGadget Soldier

legendary_quest: You can shuffle 3 "Gadget" monsters with different names from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck to Special Summon "Gadget Soldier" from your hand, also that monster gains the effects listed in your Legendary Relic.
legendary_relic:
You can Tribute Summon 1 Machine monster by tributing a "Gadget" monster you control each turn in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. A Machine monster gains the appropriate effects if Tribute Summoned by tributing these cards (Check notes):
- Green Gadget: This card gains 500 ATK.
- Red Gadget: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add 1 Machine monster from your Deck to your hand with the same level as the destroyed monster.
- Yellow Gadget: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn it is not.

legendary_quest: If you banish an opponent's monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Thunder Kid" from your hand or banishment.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): If a "Thunder Kid" you control is banished, you can banish 1 Thunder monster from your Deck. Add it to your hand during your next Draw Phase.

name: Chef

legendary_skill.name: Let Them Cook
legendary_skill.description: Declare a Recipe to use for the rest of the Duel. If you Ritual Summon, you can use an ingredient, but you cannot use ingredients for the rest of the Duel, except when Ritual Summoning a non-effect monster. You can only use each ingredient with this skill once per Duel. Your Ritual Spells can Ritual Summon any Ritual Monster, ignoring summoning conditions, by tributing monsters from your hand or field whose levels equal or exceed it.

legendary_quest: If you Ritual Summon “Hungry Burger”, you can use all your ingredients and complete your Legendary Quest.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): You can return 1 Ritual Monster you control to your hand; Special Summon 1 monster from either GY that was Tributed this turn in Defense Position, but its effects are negated, also destroy it at the end of the turn. name: Esper

legendary_skill.description: (Once per turn): You can banish 2 Psychic monsters from your GY (1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner); Special Summon 1 Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck whose Level equals the total Levels of the banished monsters, but its effects are negated.

legendary_quest: If you banish “Stinger the Electric Expeller”, Special Summon it and complete your Legendary Quest.
legendary_relic: (Once per turn): You can banish 1 Psychic monster from your Deck, and have 1 monster you control become the same level as that banished monster, also you can treat it as a tuner or a non-tuner.

name: Nephalem

legendary_skill.name: Scales of Creation
legendary_skill.description: You can Special Summon your Legendary Monsters from your hand by banishing 1 LIGHT or DARK monster from your GY with a different attribute from it.  (Once per turn): You can send up to 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your field to the GY, and draw cards equal to the amount sent. (Once per turn): If your Legendary Monster is banished, you can add it to your hand during the End Phase of this turn.

legendary_quest: If you Special Summon "Dunames Dark Witch" or "Dark Valkyria" from your hand, send the top card of your Deck to the GY and complete your Legendary Quest.
legendary_relic:
(Once per turn): You can send 1 Legendary Monster you control to the GY and Special Summon 1 with a different Attribute from your Deck. (Once per turn): You can activate 1 of the following effects:
If you control "Dunames Dark Witch" you can banish 1 DARK monster from your GY to add 1 of your banished LIGHT monsters to your hand.
If you control "Dark Valkyria" you can banish 1 LIGHT monster from your GY to add 1 of your banished DARK monsters to your hand.

name: Paladin

legendary_skill.name: Banish the Darkness
legendary_skill.description: Once per turn, during your Draw Phase: You can send 1 LIGHT Warrior monster from your Deck to the GY, then you can banish 1 DARK monster from your Deck.

legendary_quest:
If a Warrior monster you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can Special
Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your hand instead, and return all banished monsters to the GY.
legendary_relic: “Jack’s Knight” you control gains 100 ATK/DEF for every DARK or every LIGHT monster in your GY (whichever is higher). (Once per turn): You can banish any number of LIGHT monsters from your GY and return that many DARK monsters from banishment to your GY or vice-versa.
